SelectionDecision.title: SelectionDecision
SelectionDecision.description: Which compared alternative cross-validation chose, and why (arch doc §11, ADR-0044, ADR-0047): a shortlisted model, or one way of doing a preparation step. The output of a select step: immutable, like every artifact. An alternative wins only by beating the baseline on the same folds; a reference baseline wins when none does.

folds.description: Number of cross-validation folds every candidate was scored on.

repeats.description: How many times the rows were shuffled into folds (ADR-0047). Absent: once, as before repeated folds.

seed.description: Seed that shuffled the rows into folds.

baseline.description: The candidate every other must beat. As a floor, a model that ignores its features; as a reference, the rule's recommended preparation.

baseline_role.description: Absent: floor, as decided before ADR-0047 compared preparation.

winner.description: The chosen candidate. Absent: no model beats a floor baseline. A reference baseline is the winner when no alternative beats it.

not_compared.description: Alternatives the comparison did not score, each with why (ADR-0047). Absent: decided before ADR-0047 recorded them.

limitations.description: What the comparison did not cover.

SelectionMetric.description: Fixed before any score is seen: balanced_accuracy (higher is better) for classification, rmse (lower is better) for regression.

BaselineRole.description: What the baseline is for. floor: a model that ignores its features; it never wins, so no winner means no model beats it. reference: the rule's recommendation; it stands unless another alternative beats it (ADR-0047).

reason.description: Why it was not scored on the folds.

fold_scores.description: The metric on each fold's validation rows, in fold order, repeat after repeat.

spread.description: Standard deviation of the fold scores.

mean_difference.description: Mean fold-by-fold improvement over the baseline on the same folds; positive is better for either metric.

corrected_se.description: Standard error of that mean, corrected for folds that share train rows: the correction of Nadeau & Bengio (2003), applied to k-fold as in Bouckaert & Frank (2004).

p_value.description: One-sided p of the corrected repeated k-fold t-test that the alternative is no better than the baseline (Bouckaert & Frank 2004). Absent: decided by the one-SE screen, before ADR-0047's test.

beats_baseline.description: With p_value: whether the test rejects at α = 0.05 after a Holm adjustment over the other alternatives. Without: whether mean_difference is larger than one corrected_se, a screening rule.
